name: East Renfrewshire
title: East Renfrewshire —
tagline: Leafy suburbs and open moorland on Glasgow's southern edge.
summary: East Renfrewshire is south-west of Glasgow, with Giffnock, Newton Mearns, Barrhead and Neilston. It includes Whitelee Wind Farm, one of the largest onshore wind farms in Europe.
The area is known for its good schools, Rouken Glen Park and views to the Campsie Fells.

famous_for.title: Whitelee Wind Farm
famous_for.text: One of Europe's largest onshore wind farms on Eaglesham Moor.

famous_for.title: Rouken Glen Park
famous_for.text: A Victorian park with a waterfall.

places.name: Rouken Glen
places.text: A park with a walled garden.

sport.intro: Cycling, walking and golf are popular here.

community.intro: East Renfrewshire's mix of communities includes many with roots in the wider Scottish diaspora.
